Benfica season|2016–17]] | nextseason = [[2018–19 S.L. Benfica season|2018–19]] }} The 2017–18 season was [[S.L. Benfica|Sport Lisboa e Benfica]]'s [[List of S.L. Benfica seasons|114th season]] in existence and the club's [[Primeira Liga#All-time Primeira Liga table|84th consecutive season]] in the top flight of [[Football in Portugal|Portuguese football]]. It started on 5 August 2017 with Benfica's victory in the [[2017 Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira|Supertaça Cândido de Oliveira]] and concluded on 13 May 2018.{{cite news|date=28 April 2017|title=Nova época arranca no primeiro fim-de-semana de agosto|trans-title=New season starts in the first weekend of August|url=https://www.fpf.pt/pt/News/Todas-as-not%C3%ADcias/Not%C3%ADcia/news/12041|language=pt|website=[[Portuguese Football Federation|FPF]]|access-date=24 May 2017}} Benfica played in the [[2017–18 Primeira Liga|Primeira Liga]] as four-time defending champions for the first time in their history and finished second. Benfica also entered the [[2017–18 Taça de Portugal|Taça de Portugal]] as title holders but were eliminated in the fifth round. Moreover, they were eliminated in the third round of the [[2017–18 Taça da Liga|Taça da Liga]]. Internationally, Benfica competed in the [[2017–18 UEFA Champions League|UEFA Champions League]] for the eight time in a row but failed to gain a single point in the group stage for their first time, finishing with a negative goal difference of 13, which became the worst campaign of a Portuguese team in that competition.{{cite web|date=5 December 2017|title=Benfica entra para a história como a pior equipa portuguesa de sempre na Champions|language=pt|trans-title=Benfica enter history as the worst Portuguese team ever in the Champions League|url=https://desporto.sapo.pt/futebol/liga-dos-campeoes/artigos/benfica-entra-para-a-historia-como-a-pior-equipa-portuguesa-de-sempre-na-champions|website=SAPO Desporto|access-date=22 March 2019}}
